ANDROID / AUTOMATION

Coordinate Android instances from one control plane.

An emulator-management application that connects instance lifecycle, Android configuration and network settings through an API and web interface.

ProjectBlueStacks Antidetect
ScopePublic implementation
StackPython · FastAPI · ADB · SOCKS5

The problem

Managing several Android environments involves more than launching an emulator. Instance state, resource settings, device properties and network routes need to be configured and inspected together.

My contribution

  • Built instance creation, cloning and lifecycle controls exposed through a FastAPI service and web UI.
  • Integrated ADB workflows for Android configuration and device-profile management.
  • Implemented proxy configuration and validation, with diagnostic checks for the resulting environment.

How the system works

Instance requestEmulator lifecycleADB configurationNetwork setupDiagnostics

Separate the control layers. Instance management, device settings and network configuration remain distinct parts of the workflow, making each stage easier to inspect.

Use Android's automation interface. ADB provides the bridge between the Python application and actions inside the Android instance.

Verify the configured environment. Proxy validation and device diagnostics provide feedback about the setup rather than relying only on a successful configuration command.

What you can verify

The repository documents instance management, device profiles, network routing and diagnostic workflows. It demonstrates integration across a web API, emulator processes and Android tooling.

Source repository

Scope & limitations

Operation depends on a compatible BlueStacks host and Android environment. Device-profile settings and diagnostic scores do not guarantee identical behavior across applications or undetectability.
